test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: John, Kate, Lisa, Mary, Neil and Omar are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. John sits second to left of Kate. Lisa sits third to right of Kate. Mary sits to the immediate left of Lisa. Neil sits to the immediate right of Kate. How many people sit between Omar and Mary when counted from the right of Omar ?
solution:
Given series: John, Kate, Lisa, Mary, Neil and Omar are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) John sits second to left of Kate.

2) Lisa sits third to right of Kate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9325983c815a66086782e79b2a7df447347efb5aa63ac8e84e69c7a07c18c062.png] 

3) Mary sits to the immediate left of Lisa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23d4200437970be6183bf4949c11242d7881ccb0bf762bfad9c539d81cd754df.png] 

4) Neil sits to the immediate right of Kate.

After positioning Neil only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Omar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2289a00dfcd43b8474c8df6c393958887f3c35ca143488cb6a00da65c01bc583.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, two people sit between Omar and Mary when counted from the right of Omar.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
